entities.summary: Velázquez Conquest and Indigenous Resistance, a transformative movement in Cuba (1511–1550). Emerged from Diego Velázquez begins conquest of Cuba 1511 and Columbus describes Cuba as 'the most beautiful land human eyes have ever seen'. Catalyzed Spanish and Cacique Hatuey burned at the stake for resistance 1512.
